title: albizia procera var. elata
intro: Albizia procera var. elata, commonly known as the Himalayan Albizia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and relieving respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Albizia procera var. elata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which make it effective in treating conditions like bronchitis, dysentery, and menstrual disorders. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
